overview: The School Committee confronted a newly revealed multi-million-dollar gap in the upcoming fiscal year 2023 budget and heard sharp criticism from Medford Teachers Association leadership during contract negotiations. The committee also advanced a new student dress code policy, approved a resolution endorsing the statewide Fair Share Amendment, and reviewed findings from an equity audit of human resources.

items.title: Middle School Composting Pilot
items.summary: Approved a motion to investigate district-wide budgeting for a school composting program following a presentation on an Andrews Middle School pilot project.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Subcommittee Minutes
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda and adopted amended minutes from the May 25, 2022 Rules and Policy Subcommittee meeting.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent delivered district updates, and resident Derek Anderson addressed the committee during a suspension of the rules to advocate for student mental health staff and enhanced safety protocols.

items.title: HR Equity Audit Presentation
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented findings and recommendations from phase one of an equity audit of human resources conducted by The Equity Process, drawing critical feedback from committee members and the public regarding deliverables, vetting, and cost.

items.title: FY23 Operating Budget Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy presented the FY23 operating budget, outlining a projected deficit between the committee's $71.8 million request and the city's anticipated $69 million appropriation, which Mayor Lungo-Koehn attributed to an unforeseen revenue replacement calculation issue.

items.title: Medford Teachers Association Presentation
items.summary: Medford Teachers Association leadership presented arguments that city finances, ESSER funds, and Chapter 70 aid can sustain a 4% cost-of-living increase, sharply criticizing district leadership and the committee over prolonged contract negotiations.

items.title: New Dress Code Policy First Reading
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an updated district-wide student dress code policy permitting hats and hoods and establishing protections against body shaming and inequitable enforcement.

items.title: Resolution on MAP Assessment Reporting
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-36 directing the administration to submit NWEA MAP test results and action plans by school, grade, and subgroup within 30 days of each testing cycle.

items.title: Resolution in Support of Fair Share Amendment
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-37 endorsing the proposed statewide Fair Share Amendment to add a 4% surtax on annual income exceeding $1 million to fund public education and transportation.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for deceased food service worker Angela Modica before adjourning.
